title: Wave-A mappers: clubs, marinas, brokers, regions, engines
description:
Extend the mapper layer to the remaining table-dense (Wave A) entity types, reusing the parser and entity-resolution helpers. Create nodes + edges for: YachtClub (files 40, 33, 49, 60, 36, 65) with LOCATED_IN + HOSTS(Event); Marina/haul-out yard (17, 16, 55) with LOCATED_IN + CAN_SERVICE(max LOA); Company = broker/charter/management (41, 21) with BASED_IN; Region/Country/City as shared geo nodes that everything links to; EngineMaker (07) with Yacht POWERED_BY where attested; Designer with DESIGNED_BY. Normalize region names into a single canonical Region node set (dedup 'French Riviera'/'Cote d'Azur' etc.). Reuse dedup keys per type.

Part of Phase 1 (Ingestion). Region is the connective tissue - nearly every entity is geo-tagged.
acceptance_criteria: YachtClub, Marina, Company, Region, EngineMaker, and Designer nodes are created from their Wave-A source files
Region nodes are canonicalized so aliases collapse to one node and all LOCATED_IN/BASED_IN edges point to it
Edges created: club LOCATED_IN region, marina LOCATED_IN region + CAN_SERVICE maxLOA, company BASED_IN region, yacht POWERED_BY engine, yacht DESIGNED_BY designer
Each mapper validates table headers before trusting a file (skips off-schema tables)
Ingestion summary logs node/edge counts per type; counts are non-zero for each Wave-A type
